 Follow us on Facebook Twitter Hello Latest news Certain Social Security beneficiaries in the U.S. are next week due to get their monthly payment for November 2026.
 Getty Images Social Security Social Security benefits are being sent out on Wednesday, Nov. 25: who gets a payment?
 William Allen Greg Heilman Update: Nov 19th, 2026 13:23 EST 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google Across the U.S. next week, millions of Social Security beneficiaries are due to receive their November payment , as the Social Security Administration (SSA) rounds off this month’s distribution schedule for the program.
 Who gets Social Security benefits on Wednesday, Nov. 25?
 Each month, most of the U.S.’s 71.7 million Social Security beneficiaries are paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday . Under this system, a recipient’s designated payment date depends on their birthday.
 As it is the fourth Wednesday in the month, November 25 will see benefits issued to recipients born from the 21st to 31st of any month .
 November’s full three-Wednesdays cycle is:
 Born on 1st-10th of month: Tuesday, Nov. 10 (paid a day early as Nov. 11 was a federal holiday) 
 Born on 11th-20th of month: Wednesday, Nov. 18 
 Born on 21st-31st of month: Wednesday, Nov. 25 
 NB: If you get Social Security benefits based on someone else’s employment history, the SSA uses the other person’s birthday to determine your payment Wednesday.
 What other Social Security payment dates are there in November?
 November 25 is the last of four payment dates on the Social Security schedule for this month. 
 Before the three-Wednesdays cycle began, benefits went out to two groups of recipients whose monthly distribution date is not determined by their birthday:
 Nov. 3: Social Security paid to dual beneficiaries and certain long-term recipients 
 On Tuesday 3 , November’s Social Security was paid to recipients who have been getting their monthly payments since before May 1997 . 
 Tuesday 3 was also this month’s Social Security payment date for individuals who combine the benefit with Supplemental Security Income (SSI).
 A needs-based scheme for certain low-income Americans , SSI is separate to the Social Security scheme , despite also being administered by the SSA.
 Unlike Social Security, claimants to the SSI program do not need to earn work credits to qualify. Worth up to $994 per month to individual beneficiaries (plus a potential state supplement ), SSI was paid out for November on Friday, October 30 . 
 Social Security benefits - average monthly amounts:
 Retirement: $2,037.84 
 Disability: $1,500.84 
 Survivor: $1,636.75 
 Source: The Social Security Administration’s ‘monthly statistical snapshot’, released in Nov. 2026.
 How much is the 2027 COLA?
 In a bid to protect beneficiaries’ purchasing power, the SSA is to up Social Security and SSI amounts by 3.6% in 2027 . 
 Across all Social Security recipients, this means an increase of about $70 on the current average monthly payment, listed by the SSA at $1,946.23.
 Recipients of retirement benefits, who account for over three-quarters of all Social Security claimants, can expect an average pay rise of around $75 , the SSA says .
 How does the Social Security Administration pay benefits?
 Direct deposit 
 Social Security recipients can supply the SSA with their bank details on the online “ my Social Security ” portal.
 Direct Express 
 Money can be loaded onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for recipients without a bank account. Sign up at 1-800-333-1795 or 1-800-772-1213, or at a Social Security office.
